Clinical Evaluation

Common Concerns We Evaluate

Persistent joint or back discomfort can make routine movements distressing. An in-person consultation allows for an accurate physical assessment of your situation.

🚶‍♂️

Difficulty Walking or Climbing Stairs

Morning stiffness in the knees, swelling after walking, or a grating / grinding sensation that makes climbing up or down stairs challenging.

🪑

Pain While Sitting, Standing or Getting Up

Sharp or aching lower-back stiffness when getting out of bed, rising from chairs, or standing for more than 15 minutes.

⏱️

Persistent Knee or Back Discomfort

Joint pain or sciatica tingling that has persisted over weeks or months, and has not responded satisfactorily to temporary pain relief tablets or generic ointments.

📋

Uncertainty About Treatment Options

Looking for an experienced Ayurvedic medical perspective to understand non-surgical therapies, joint mobility support, lifestyle changes, and when specialized referral is needed.

Medical Note: Clinical outcomes depend on individual joint condition, medical history, age, and adherence to therapeutic protocols. Dr. Surabhi conducts an individual assessment to determine appropriate care.

Practitioner Background

Meet Dr. Surabhi Vaidya

Dr. Surabhi Sunil Vaidya (BAMS, MBA) is an Ayurvedic physician and the founder of Charak Health Solutions in Thane West. With over 15 years of dedicated clinical practice in Thane, her clinical focus is on helping patients understand chronic knee osteoarthritis, lumbar spine discomfort, and sciatica through the foundational diagnostic methods of Ayurveda. Knee & Back Pain Relief (kneeandbackpainrelief.com) serves as the clinic's dedicated consultation portal for non-surgical joint care.

Our Clinical Assessment Approach

During your visit, Dr. Surabhi takes time to evaluate your situation thoroughly:

  • Naadi Pariksha (Pulse Assessment): Traditional Ayurvedic pulse evaluation to understand your body's constitutional balance and metabolic factors (Vata imbalance).
  • Physical Joint & Spine Mobility Check: Examination of knee flexion, joint crepitus, gait pattern, and spinal flexibility.
  • Diagnostic Report Review: Careful examination of your existing X-rays, MRI scans, and blood reports to correlate clinical findings with modern imaging.
  • Honest Guidance: A transparent discussion of whether Ayurvedic therapies are suitable for your stage of condition, or whether referral to an orthopaedic surgeon is medically indicated.

Patient Experience

What Happens During Your Consultation?

A structured, 30-minute in-person assessment designed to give you clarity on your joint health.

Step 1

Discuss Symptoms, History & Existing Reports

We review when your pain began, daily activities that trigger discomfort, previous treatments tried, and any existing X-ray or MRI scans you bring.

Step 2

Receive an Individual Clinical Assessment

Dr. Surabhi conducts an in-person physical joint check, posture examination, and pulse diagnosis to evaluate joint alignment and localized inflammation.

Step 3

Discuss Care Options, Follow-Up or Referral

You receive practical advice on tailored Ayurvedic management, joint care exercises, and lifestyle adjustments. If surgery or hospital care is necessary, an ethical referral is recommended.
